DDInter175.mechanism: High doses of anticholinergic agents may attenuate the response to secretin and cause false-positive results. Anticholinergics inhibit gastric acid secretion. Clinicians should be aware of the potential for inaccurate test results when administering secretin to patients treated with anticholinergic drugs.
